about: Words in a spec that mean its build changes what tools/gen compiles, so its Lanes must include gen. Kickoff holds an item whose spec has one of these without a gen lane and comments "spec: gen lane missing" on its issue for the Release Planner. Each keyword is a regex (case-insensitive), the spec fields it is looked for in, and what the comment says. Release Planner (Walter) extends this list. Added by Kaizen (Gale), 2026-10-20, after spec-incomplete-files three times in one day: #501, #504, and #503, whose PR #565 touched tools/gen.
